description: This file defines an ApprovalService class that manages submission approval workflows, including validation of electronic signatures, state transitions, and auditing. It handles approval decisions, signature verification, and interacts with related services like audit and evidence management. Custom exceptions are defined for error handling.

classes.description: Base exception class for approval-related errors

classes.name: SignatureError

classes.name: InvalidStateError
classes.description: Exception for invalid workflow state transitions
